The '''Battle of Balamak''' saw the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] employ an experimental [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] platform in an attempt to disrupt [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmissions in the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]], a region in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Background==
A CIS [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] appeared over [[Balamak/Legends|Balamak]], an important [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]-producing world that hosted a key HoloNet node, and established a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]. One of the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] was a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] with a modified transmission array to broadcast jamming signals capable of disrupting all transmission networks in the entire [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

==The battle==
The jamming continued for four [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] until a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force, led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Nanda-Ree Janoo]], engaged the flotilla with a massed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] attack. Starfighter tactician [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] planned the attack, during which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] delivered the final [[Missile/Legends|missile]] volley that destroyed the jamming craft. The remaining Separatist forces were routed.
